tast: Improve SSH's API to push files. SSH.PutTreeRename used to take the base directory in the local and remote host and files were specified in paths relative to the base directory. Assumption here was that we usually want to push files under a base directory, but it is not true today especially when a test bundle binary and local_test_runner are pushed at once. This CL changes the method to take just one map whose key is an absolute/relative path to a local file and value is an absolute path to a remote file. Since we no longer have concept of the base directory, the method is renamed from PutTreeRename to PutFiles. autotest: network_TwoShills: Stop assuming default routes are in main table Prior to CL:1590183, all default routes were placed in the main routing table. Now that per-device routing tables are used, default routes for a particular device are placed in the device's corresponding routing table. Since `ip route show` only shows routes in the main routing table, it is expected that `ip route show default match 0/0` will not return anything. Appending ' table 0' to the command causes routes from all routing tables to be dumped, rather than just the main routing table. Note that this change will not break network_TwoShills on devices running images before 77, as in that case adding ' table 0' will not do anything. BUG=chromium:982504, chromium:941597 TEST=`test_that $BOARD $HOST network_TwoShills` failed before this change but now passes. Change-Id: Ic52d33b53ec4326b647787c022c8956178b9c61b Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1696227 Tested-by: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Kirtika Ruchandani <kirtika@chromium.org>

cryptohome: CheckKeyEx support for chall-resp keys Add support of the challenge-response keys (a.k.a. smart card login keys) into the CheckKeyEx operation. This allows to implement unlocking at the Lock Screen for the users who log into smart cards. Performance note: Currently, for the sake of simplicity, the implementation follows full procedure needed for the decryption of the smart card user's vault keyset. This can be optimized in the future, when the ChallengeCredentialsHelper::Verify() operation is implemented, since this implementation will need only one challenge (versus the currently needed two challenges) and won't do round-trip through the TPM chip. BUG=chromium:842791 TEST=manual, add CheckKeyEx calls into the ChallengeResponseMount Tast test Change-Id: Ifa7564088e1cfd89bc0f6fc9b625c334c91a70e0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1678661 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ryo Hashimoto <hashimoto@chromium.org>
